scope: Global server; candidate race-mechanics boundaries only
summary: Two major Global race-mechanics changes are documented in the located announcements and contemporary discussion: November 11, 2025 and July 1, 2026. These findings identify research boundaries, not complete simulator or inference support windows.

boundaries.label: Global half-anniversary balance update
reportedChanges: Spot Struggle, Dueling, and Runaway aptitude
Hills, final-corner positioning, navigation/passing behavior, and late recovery
boundaries.uncertainty: The initial 08:00 UTC time was superseded by maintenance extension to around 10:00 UTC. This research did not independently retrieve the final completion announcement. Do not treat the initially advertised time as a proven mechanics cutover.

boundaries.label: Global July 2026 balance update
reportedChanges: Front Runner behavior depending on the presence of other Front Runners
Position-adjustment speed reduction, frequency, and mechanics
Rushing-related debuffs and effects of stats above 1200
boundaries.communityInterpretation: Post-release guides broadly associate the package with Japanese second-anniversary balance changes; pre-release discussion described a mixture of Japanese 1.5- and second-anniversary changes. Neither description establishes identical implementations or dates across regions.
boundaries.uncertainty: The 11:00 UTC completion text was retrieved through an aggregator of the official account; the original post was inaccessible to the web tool. Announcement copies warn about careers started around the update and state that saved race progression is unchanged.

engineEvidence.findings: The pinned source documents Spot Struggle, Dueling, reconstructed positioning, spurt planning, and a Conserve Power interval ledger. Its accuracy report evaluates captured Global races and does not publish an original-race-date support interval. It explicitly retains approximations for unsupported Conserve Power cases and optional later stamina mechanics.
engineEvidence.mappingStatus: Post-July mechanics alignment is plausible from the source and contemporary race validation, but these facts do not prove a complete historical support interval. Engine implementation versions are separate from official game client versions.

mappingRecommendations: Use original race occurrence with established UTC offset and precision; preserve date evidence when reopening or exporting races.
Keep Global boundaries separate from Japanese anniversary dates and banner/scenario schedules.
Record announced, revised, and confirmed completion timestamps independently; retain ambiguity across maintenance transitions.
Store explicit user-approved bounded date ranges together with their evidence and distinct simulator/inference artifact identities.

Allow unknown-version simulator trials under the user's updated policy, but require independent recorded-output agreement before exposing simulated analysis; do not use that trial as an inference authorization or as proof of an official ruleset.
No later broad Global race-mechanics balance update was established by this search through October 17, 2026; absence from search results is not proof that none occurred.
